name: jactionlint
description: :octocat: Static checker for GitHub Actions workflow files

paragraphs: Catch broken and insecure GitHub Actions workflows before they run.

jactionlint is a static checker for GitHub Actions. It reads your workflows, composite actions and dependabot.yml and reports two kinds of problems: the mistakes that make a run fail or misbehave, and the patterns that let an outsider run code in your repository or steal its token. It started as a fork of actionlint and covers its checks, and its security rules follow the audits of zizmor.
features: Correctness. Unknown keys and events, type errors in ${{ }} expressions, wrong inputs of actions and reusable workflows, and broken needs:, cron and glob patterns. shellcheck and pyflakes check the scripts of run: steps.
Security. Script injection, excessive token permissions, dangerous triggers such as pullrequesttarget, cache poisoning, credentials left in the checkout and AI agent actions that outsiders can steer.
Policy. Actions used by a tag instead of a commit, and workflows without permissions:, a job timeout or a concurrency group.
Fixes. jactionlint --fix repairs what has a mechanical fix, and --diff shows the change first.
Gradual adoption. Profiles choose how much is checked, and a baseline fails the build only on new findings.

whatItDoes.text: Catch broken and insecure GitHub Actions workflows before they run.
